name: ans

scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:web
scripts.build:contracts: node scripts/sync-upgrade-fixture.mjs && node scripts/sync-v4.mjs && cd contracts && node ../scripts/aztec.mjs compile
scripts.check: npm run build:sdk && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:sdk && npm test -w @ans/web && npm test -w ans-e2e && npm test -w @ans/ops && npm run test:pricing && npm run test:bundles && npm run test:deployment && npm run check:deployment && npm run test:brillig
scripts.test:contracts: cd contracts && node ../scripts/aztec.mjs test --package name_registry --test-threads 2 && node ../scripts/aztec.mjs test --package name_registrar --test-threads 2 && node ../scripts/aztec.mjs test --package name_registry_v4 --test-threads 2 && node ../scripts/aztec.mjs test --package name_registry_v5 --test-threads 2 && node ../scripts/aztec.mjs test --package name_registry_v6 --test-threads 2 && node ../scripts/aztec.mjs test --package name_registrar_tiered --test-threads 2 && node ../scripts/aztec.mjs test --package name_registrar_launch --test-threads 2 && node ../scripts/aztec.mjs test --package name_registry_v7 --test-threads 2
scripts.test:web: npm run smoke -w @ans/web && npm run smoke:review -w @ans/web && npm run smoke:storage -w @ans/web && npm run smoke:retry -w @ans/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:sdk && npm run dev -w @ans/web

description: Aztec name service: contracts, TypeScript SDK and web app
